parser.accepted_tokens: any 64-character hexadecimal token found in the value
parser.malformed_tokens: ignored; no malformed value grants trust

directory_allowlist.scope: module path equal to or within a configured directory

hash_cases.expected_context: untrusted context; main cells never receive trusted package capabilities

context_selection.trusted_hash: hash exact resolved entrypoint bytes before evaluation
context_selection.trusted_dynamic_import: trusted importer keeps its dependency graph in the trusted VM context
context_selection.untrusted_dynamic_import: matching hash or configured trusted directory may cross into trusted context at the import boundary
context_selection.path_only: path name, directory ownership, package name, or symlink identity alone is insufficient
context_selection.realpath: used for directory containment checks, not as a replacement for byte hashing

token_properties: generated once for the kernel generation
carried by privileged and native-pipe requests
accepted only for the active child generation
replay from an old generation rejected

wrong_hash_ordering: reject before evaluating the privileged module and before any native socket connect(2)
